titulo.alumno:
«Корреляция не всегда означает причину»
Correlation and causation

intro: If two phenomena vary together, that alone does not prove that one causes the other; other variables and the method must be considered.

piezas.titulo: If two phenomena vary together, that alone does not prove that one causes the other; other variables and the method must be considered.
texto: If two phenomena vary together, that alone does not prove that one causes the other; other variables and the method must be considered.
Cautious reports include вероятно, может быть связано and авторы не исключают; respect those limits when interpreting.

frases.estudio: В районах с большим числом парков жители чаще ходят пешком.

frases.alumno: The authors note a link, but do not claim that the parks by themselves caused the change.
